coherence_findings.issue: Loudon Live set down its scaffolded curriculum on 2026-09-26 (Loudon Live.md § Lost branches: 'A scaffolded curriculum ... set down 2026-09-26 in favor of a looser presence'). Six siblings still talk in the old vocabulary: Phoneme Choir and Talking Keyboard end their forward vectors on 'a Stage 4 Loudon Live demo'; Blood Compressor lists 'Stage 4 — Author the lesson: a 30-minute Loudon Live session'; Waveguide has a section 'Tiers Toward Loudon Live' ending 'Stage-ready'; Floquet's Forward Vector says 'The arc ships across five sessions' although its own scroll was revised the same day (2026-09-26, 'the stages are builds, not sessions'); Generative Preset Development labels its Loudon Live link 'curriculum-fuel'.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Say it once, in Loudon's current terms: a project can be built in public on Loudon Live when Loudon picks it. Replace 'Stage 4 Loudon Live demo' / 'Stage-ready' / 'five sessions' with the plain move (play it for people; build it on stream). Keep the word 'stage' for the page lifecycle and for Progressive Staging steps, and drop it as a number attached to Loudon Live. Taste-level wording, so offer it, don't apply it.

coherence_findings.issue: 'Tier' means four things in this family: Shop build tiers (Sketch / Study / Piece in Waveguide § Tiers Toward Loudon Live and Murmuration § Status), openness of a synth's format (Generative Preset Development 'Tier 1-4'), warp cost and surface class (2D Torus 'Tier 1 / Tier 2'). Generative Preset Development also contradicts itself: its heading is 'Tier 4 - Profile Generalizer (the endgame)' but the Notes for Future Claude Instances say 'until Stage 4's Profile Generalizer concept is mature'.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: In Generative Preset Development change 'Stage 4's Profile Generalizer' to 'Tier 4's' (a plain slip). Elsewhere gloss the tier once where it first appears ('build tier' for Sketch/Study/Piece). No renaming project-wide.

summary: Read all 25 members (frontmatter all, bodies of the load-bearing ones, scrolls and tuning ledgers where the entry leans on them) plus the siblings and shared pages named in pages_read. Partway through, commit 0dba352d landed in the tree: it folded many links the brief lists (2D Torus to Loudon Live, Palace Enchantment to Project Stewardship System, Phoneme Choir to Talking Keyboard, Swarm Weave's Lateral Access duplicate) and deleted Frequency-Time Explorer, so I re-read every member's links and proposed against the tree as it now stands. The family's main incoherence is staleness, not conflict: pages still speak in the Loudon Live curriculum vocabulary set down on 2026-09-26 and in the Max/RNBO path that the 2026-10-16 pause and 2026-10-21 VST decision replaced, while their scrolls and tuning ledgers are current. The strongest finds are Portamento's forward vector asking for the ear-training pairs that curated-ear-set already ships, Generative Wavetable Libraries answering its own two open questions and sitting nine cycles behind its steward, and a GWL Floquet table that the Floquet project does not know exists. Links: most of the unlabelled or generic ones are cut or labelled; two are retyped (Compressor Design/Retrospective Delay to mirrors, Swarm Weave/Palace Enchantment to enables, the latter a judgment); one pair of cuts needs Loudon's eye (BLUELINE to Retrospective Delay). Two newcomer links to VST Template are offered because each page already says the reason in words. Memory: eight Contexts earn their place on weight (Floquet, Palace Enchantment, Swarm Weave, 2D Torus, BLUELINE, Inharmonic, Loudon Live, Portamento), one scroll (STIGMERGY Philosophical Lenses), and no tuning ledgers should be opened by hand. One tentative merge (Talking Keyboard into Phoneme Choir, Loudon's call). Unsettled: whether Swarm Weave's Deposit Ceremony Step 7.5 ever existed, whether Compressor Design's retrospective quotes are from real students, and the Mathieu-functions-under-hyperbolic-geometry line in Bessel (flagged, not rewritten).
